<div class="card-body">
'''Blue Milk''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used or Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ブルー・ミルク</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：どちらか一方のプレイヤーが1フォースを起動する。ロスト：「ジュリ・ジュース」または「ハイポ」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Blue-Milk-PSA-159081590.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">モイスチャー・ファームで常飲される栄養価の高い飲み物。薬効作用もあるといわれている。カンティーナでもジュリ・ジュースの飲めない者には人気。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blue milk.

'''Card text:'''
USED: Either player activates 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Juri Juice or Hypo.

'''Lore:'''
A nutrient-rich drink always consumed on moisture farms. It also has medicinal effects. In cantinas it is popular with those who cannot drink juri juice.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blue Milk]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
